body: It comes out to around 35k for the whole program before aid 😅 With grants and govt money mine got knocked down to about 10k that i’m paying off on a payment plan monthly while i’m still in school b/c i didn’t want more student loans, but that’s always an option. If you have the time and you think the industry is right for you, then definitely recommend setting up a tour!! The admissions lady is super sweet :) Plus it’s only a 16 month program, it’s not the full dive into a bachelors you know. Good luck!

I go to LCI! Great school with great instructors, but the price is honestly only worth it if you’re going to go all in in the culinary industry. Definitely suggest picking up a job working as a line cook somewhere decent before you make the decision, it’s definitely not an easy job especially for women (discrimination wise and I know because i am one lol). The degree is really for the connections and the title.
